info.name: University Directory Service (Group 5)
info.description:
Functional tests for the University Directory Service API v1.

Run folders in order (0 to 9). Folder 0 logs in through the Identity Service; every later request uses those tokens. All data created is synthetic, uniquely suffixed per run, and removed again in folder 9.

Environment: docs/postman/directory-service.local.postman_environment.json. Fill in the synthetic demo credentials locally; never commit them.

item.name: 0. Setup
item.description: Gets tokens from the Identity Service. Fill the credentials in the environment (never commit them).
